verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an Applications surface: partners pre-fill an application, the applicant finishes sign-up in the UI, the CLI has an 'applications' command, and an applications:read scope exists to 'manage financing applications'. That implies applications can be read back, but nothing shows a founder viewing review status. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of checking application status during review, a founder-facing status view in the UI, status-change notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
